purpose: Create a browse layer for classical formulas before importing individual formula records. Categories support NCCAOM study, clinical lookup, public English articles, condition links, and herb-drug safety review.

content_policy.private_study: Use Chinese and English references as study maps.
content_policy.public_ready: Rewrite in original English, cite sources, and verify formula claims against professional formula texts and safety sources.
content_policy.safety: Formula use must be tied to pattern differentiation, contraindications, pregnancy/lactation cautions, medication interactions, and referral flags.
